boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Non-Show Days: We are open 12pm-5pm Wednesday and Friday, Show Days: 2 hours prior to doors (time shown on website) through 15 minutes after headliner takes the stage.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: The Bogarts Box Office accepts Discover, MasterCard, Visa, and American Express. NO CHECKS or CASH. We are a cashless venue. If you do only have cash, you will be able to convert your cash into a prepaid debit card, without any service fees.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call orders can be picked up on the day of the show with a photo ID, and your confirmation number. Alternate Will Call Pick Up: If another person, other than the person ordering and paying for the tickets, is picking up a WILL CALL order, the ALTERNATE PICK-UP name MUST be on the account. To get the alternate pick-up name noted on the account, the original purchaser MUST contact Ticketmaster at (800) 745-3000 ask for customer service, verify account information, and request alternate pick-up.

venues.parkingDetail: Pay parking lots are available across from and behind the building. Metered parking is available on the street (Free Sunday, holidays, and weekdays after 6pm). Please note that Bogart's does not operate any parking lots. Bogart's is also very accessible for rideshares. Additionally, Bogart's has partnered with ParkWhiz to offer other parking options that can be booked in advance.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Bogarts 1st level (Main Bar, Mezzanine, GA Floor) is accessible by both wheelchair ramp and elevator. Purchase any available ticket at any location. Our ADA seating section is located on our Mezzanine which is accessible by wheelchair ramp.

generalInfo.generalRule: Doors: Doors usually open one hour prior to the show time unless otherwise noted. We recommend you arrive early. General Admission: Bogarts is a standing room only general admission house. Camera Policy: Personal point and shoot cameras are allowed in the venue. Flash photography, video and removable lens cameras are not permitted without venue approval.
generalInfo.childRule: Most shows are all ages events and children are welcome. Some shows may have an age limit of 18 and over which will be specified on our event calendar.

accessibility.info:
Accessible seating is available for wheelchairs and companions.  There is a 4 ticket limit for all accessible seating, unless otherwise posted.

Wheelchair patrons should purchase 1 wheelchair seat as their seat and up to 3 companion seats.  Wheelchair companions should also purchase wheelchair seats as their seat.

Please Note: Hearing impaired patrons should contact the box office directly to purchase tickets to ensure additional accommodations are in place.  The box office can be reached by phone at (513) 621-8383 during regular business hours.

Accessible seats are located in Sections 101, 120, 146, 303, 307, 315, 337, 339 and 347 of the stadium.  More information is available by calling (513) 621-8383 during normal business hours or on game days at the Customer Service windows of the North Ticket Office located by Gate C.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: For the Bengals Box Office: Mon-Fri: 9:00am to 5:00pm Day of game: 3 hours prior to kickoff to halftime For all other Stadium events: Box Office hours for all non-Bengals events may vary on the day of the event

venues.parkingDetail: There are numerous public and private parking lots around the stadium. South of Third Street adjacent to the stadium is sold out with pre-paid season parking. West of Central Avenue is limited game-by-game parking. TANK has various shuttle pickups throughout Northern Kentucky.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating: for Bengals games refer to box office (513) 621-TDTD (8383). For Music/Jazz Festival refer to (513) 924-0900. For all other Paycor Stadium events refer to Ticketmaster 1-800-745-3000.

generalInfo.generalRule: Cameras: are permitted Recording devices: are permitted (copyright laws apply) There is a full range of food and beverage items and souvenir items sold within the stadium. To ensure that all guests have a safe and enjoyable visit to Paycor Stadium, please visit bengals.com for the most up to date list prohibited items and bags policy, http://www.bengals.com/stadium/prohibited-items.html. Prohibited items that are discovered during security inspections must either be returned to the owner s vehicle or discarded. No item may be left at the gate. All other items that enter the stadium are subject to a visual search.
generalInfo.childRule: All patrons ages two years and older need a ticket. A child under two years old can sit on the lap of a ticket holder and will not be required to have a ticket. One infant may be admitted per ticket holder. The Bengals ask fans with children to be considerate of those around them.
